title: A compatible nowhere-zero integral multiplier is rationally invertible
statement: Let ℓ be prime and E a normed field over ℚ_ℓ, with continuous coefficient sheaves as in [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. Let X be a scheme, and let e:R_X≅C_X(O_E) and eE:S_X≅C_X(E) be monoid-object realizations compatible with the integral-to-field coefficient inclusion. A regular R_X-module endomorphism p whose coefficient under e is nowhere zero becomes invertible after scalar extension R_X→S_X.

source.place: Section 6.8, Definition 6.8.10 and Proposition 6.8.11(1): integral coefficient framework and kernel-closure application; the displayed continuous-function pivot argument is an agent reduction, not a matrix argument written out in Lemma 6.8.7

proof.text: Conjugate p by e to obtain its continuous coefficient b. Construct the continuous E-valued multiplier qE by the image of b. Its reciprocal gives an inverse because b is nowhere zero.

Transport qE back along the field realization to a regular S_X-endomorphism q. The compatibility square for the two realizations and the pointwise multiplication formula prove p.hom≫φ=φ≫q.hom, where φ is the actual coefficient map.
The proved regular scalar-extension comparison intertwines scalar extension of p with q. Conjugating the isomorphism q by this comparison proves the required IsIso.

theorem integralRegular_rationalUnit_of_nowhereZero (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : Type) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (e : condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X ⟶
      (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).obj
        (continuousMapRingSheaf X (continuousIntegers ℓ E))) [IsIso e] [IsMonHom e]
    (eE : condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X ⟶
      continuousAbRing X E) [IsIso eE] [IsMonHom eE]
    (he : coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X ≫ eE =
      e ≫ integralFunctionInclusion ℓ E X)
    (p : Mod.regular (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) ⟶
      Mod.regular (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X))
    (hp : ∀ x, ((((inv e ≫ p.hom ≫ e).hom.app
      (op (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 X)))) (ULift.up 1)).down x).val ≠ 0) :
    IsIso ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).map p)
